summaries.Good news: Indigenous forest protectors in Peru are actively preventing wildfires through traditional knowledge, while a 12-year-old's annual diaper drive delivered 30,000 diapers to families in need—real grassroots change happening now.
summaries.Ideas: AI agents are becoming increasingly autonomous but unpredictable, raising safety concerns as OpenAI delays model releases and researchers warn of existential risks, while the business world races to capitalize on the technology.
summaries.Technology: SpaceX's Starship successfully reached orbit despite engine failures, while practical innovations like e-readers designed to fight doomscrolling and modular camping trailers show design thinking solving everyday problems.
summaries.Design: Design schools like Tecnológico de Monterrey and established studios are reimagining spaces—from volcanic stone lamps to stadium-inspired offices—while independent design collectives are reshaping how creative communities organize themselves.
